infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PriceFinder BD uses the camera to scan product barcodes and take product photos for price comparison.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PriceFinder BD uses your location to discover the closest verified shops and provide turn-by-turn directions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PriceFinder BD needs access to your photos to identify products from saved images.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow PriceFinder BD to access your camera to scan product barcodes.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow PriceFinder BD to find verified shops near you.
